seatedToss.guidance: Tarakai mo etafula, mu yanuke okuningwa ombinda yoyoro mo ekuhu lonene. Komeho kakeho mo ekuhu, nomukanda nawo.
steps: Tanga ekuhu lokuningwa nomukanda wokuvara, u rarare etafula pokati penu.
Tarakai nawa, mumwe ko mumwe. Yanukeni rimwe rimwe, nari mu hindire mu tambe.
Ombinda rikaningwa mo ekuhu, omuntu wa ningwa ota tayi ondango imwe mo mukanda wowe, mo mutanda womuhuhu mo tete.
Mu tarakai ozi tiri pamwe mu hepa, mu kamwe. Hakuna omuntu ana ta tahana okuverenga.
Yendeni po nomuzuvakwe mu tambe ngao.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Tjiva ombinda ine ekuhu rokanona nari ekaraza rokuveta, tarakai, kapi ningwa kohi yomutwe, nomukuru apo ri kure nawo. Ozondjiro ondikitu zi ri ngozo yokutingirwa.
safety: Tjiva ombinda ine ekuhu rokanona, nari u tjivereke okasoki ketoke. Mu tarise nawa kuvesa kokuzi ngeno ouhoro, ndi kapi ko mahungu.
Ombinda, ondjiro nomaya ozo zi kanda okutingirwa. Ziherereni kure ko vana ovana nomuntu wa ngo wa ka tora kanwa.
Mu hepe pokuzari ko moko, u mu tarise nawa kuvilira ozondjiro zi kanwe.
Tarakai nawa. Ningwa ombinda ko ngeno pokaravo ko etafula, kapi kohi yomutwe.

pictureBingo.guidance: Uta nokutjanga otuara kombapira. O raisa omuisane kokatara okanene ku u na nako.

calmBreathing.guidance: Huura mo indu otjiyingo tji matji kuru, nu u huure pondje tji matji titi. Matji zikama owatjo kombunda yomihuuro ihamboumwe.
calmBreathing.ready: Mwe rirongere indu tji mwa vanga
calmBreathing.started: Twa utu. Huura mo indu otjiyingo tji matji kuru.
calmBreathing.finished: Oyo ya ri omihuuro ihamboumwe omiporote. Utisa rukwao indu tji mo vanga.

storyChain.guidance: Mu tambulana: 1 onyaniko yomuhuna, mu yandjise ofoto yomaiko.
storyChain.passNote: Tja onyaniko yoye nondjiwa. Kakuna kunyorwa nari kukarwa. Omuntu wa wina ngwe a yandja kusha.
storyChain.fullAdd: Ongambo ye yuzu. Tangisa ongambo yomupya
storyChain.full: Ongambo ine ofoto 8 nawa. Hindura onyaniko yonuwo, nari tangisa ongambo yomupya.
